findings.title: `queued` is evaluated once at module import rather than per AssignmentSource
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is executed when the dataclass is defined, so every `AssignmentSource` created for the lifetime of a worker/process receives the same `queued` timestamp. This makes the serialized context inaccurate and would break any ordering, expiration, or debugging based on when an assignment was queued. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each instance records its own creation time.
